basic_details.job_title: DHS North & Middle Andaman Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The District Health Society, North & Middle Andaman, Mayabunder has invited online applications through the Apprenticeship India Portal for the engagement of eligible candidates as Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Interested and eligible candidates can submit their online applications up to 07.11.2026 by 12:00 Midnight through the official apprenticeship portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/.

age_limit.details: The age limit shall be determined as per the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the applicable rules and guidelines framed thereunder.

qualification.details: The official notification does not mention the minimum educational or technical qualifications required for each trade. Qualifications depend upon the educational and technical standards established for the specific apprenticeship category.

salary_details.details: Selected apprentices shall be paid a stipend at the rates prescribed under the applicable rules and guidelines. The stipend amount depends upon the candidate's educational or technical qualification, skill levels, and the category of apprenticeship. The duration of the apprenticeship shall follow the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 and applicable rules.

selection_process: The selection process for the engagement of apprentices is governed by the provisions of the Apprentices Act
taking into account the educational and technical qualifications of candidates.
how_to_apply: Visit the official Apprenticeship India Portal at the provided official website link.
Register or enroll yourself on the portal by entering the required personal and educational details.
Search for the establishment: District Health Society, North & Middle Andaman, Mayabunder.
Submit your application online through the portal on or before 07.11.2026 up to 12:00 Midnight.
Ensure all eligibility criteria are met before final submission, as mere submission does not confer any right for engagement.
important_instructions: Applications received after the stipulated date and time (07.11.2026 up to 12:00 Midnight) shall not be considered. Candidates must ensure they fulfill all prescribed eligibility criteria before applying. Mere submission of an online application does not confer any legal right for engagement as an Apprentice. The Chairperson, District Health Society, North & Middle Andaman, Mayabunder reserves the right to modify or cancel the engagement process or alter the number of apprenticeship seats as per requirements.

content_sections.heading: About District Health Society North & Middle Andaman Apprentice
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, North & Middle Andaman, Mayabunder operates under the framework of the Apprentices Act, 1961 to engage apprentices across available seats in the district. Candidates are selected based on provisions set by the governing rules and guidelines of the Apprenticeship India Portal.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention the minimum educational or technical qualifications required for each trade. Qualifications depend upon the educational and technical standards established for the specific apprenticeship category. The age limit shall be determined as per the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the applicable rules and guidelines framed thereunder.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices shall be paid a stipend at the rates prescribed under the applicable rules and guidelines. The stipend amount depends upon the candidate's educational or technical qualification, skill levels, and the category of apprenticeship. The duration of the apprenticeship shall follow the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 and applicable rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Health Society North & Middle Andaman Apprentice
content_sections.text: Visit the official Apprenticeship India Portal at the provided official website link. Register or enroll yourself on the portal by entering the required personal and educational details. Search for the establishment: District Health Society, North & Middle Andaman, Mayabunder. Submit your application online through the portal on or before 07.11.2026 up to 12:00 Midnight. Ensure all eligibility criteria are met before final submission, as mere submission does not confer any right for engagement.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for the engagement of apprentices is governed by the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the rules framed thereunder, taking into account the educational and technical qualifications of candidates.
